description: What Medicare pricing data is loaded and how current it is: the fee-schedule years and quarters held, how many codes are in each dataset, how many localities, and the PTP pair-edit change window. Use to check a vintage is current enough to quote before relying on a rate, and to see the scope limit on check_code_pair / explain_ncci_edit — they see only pairs that changed within the loaded quarterly window, not the full AMA-licence-gated PTP baseline.
name: medicare_pricing_coverage
title: Medicare Pricing Coverage
